name: New line - Pixel 11 Pro $0 with trade-in - Premium 2.0
description: Offers checked on att.com/buy/phones and att.com/bundles/internet-wireless on 2026-11-22. Customer voice: terse, tech-savvy.
scripted_messages: Pixel 11 Pro, listed at $0/mo with eligible trade-in. Trading a Pixel 8 Pro, paid off, no damage. One new line coming from Mint Mobile, a new number is fine. Zip 85004, no AT&T account. What's the monthly total on Premium 2.0? Info only, I'll order online.
Thanks. Does Premium 2.0 include the 100GB hotspot?
And what does the first bill look like with taxes and fees included?
Fair enough. Slightly higher than I'd like, but your answers were quick and clear, thanks. You'll get a good rating from me.
That's all. Have a good one, bye.
_expected_agent_flow: before message 1: agent: greeting, asks for first and last name
before message 2: agent: welcomes the customer, asks how they can help
before message 3: agent: 'please give me a moment' while checking
before message 4: agent: gives the answer/quote
before message 5: agent: answers the follow-up (a bill question usually gets 'please allow me a moment to calculate')
before message 6: agent: waiting message while calculating the bill
before message 7: agent: gives the detail / the calculated bill
before message 8: agent: 'Is there anything else I can help you with today?'
